Using a heat exchanger to keep hydroponic rez temps low

Ok. So you're trying to DYI a heat exchanger for your plants?

How about: Get on Craigslist, find a small room freezer or fridge. Get some flexible PVC tube, drill a hole through the insulation in said fridge, and run a lot of tube into the fridge/freezer in a circle. Cram in as much as you can, reasonably.

Drill another hole for your exit, run the tube through, and hook it up to a small impeller which will push/pull the water through your system. Hook it up to your nutrient flow from the grow, it should work fairly well if you close up the gaps from the holes your drilled.
